definitions: These thresholds are chosen study gates, not measured errors or source-reported uncertainty.

comparison.ReTheta_resampling: Interpolate each actual scalar Cf curve onto predeclared reference ReTheta; no extrapolation. Record station displacement as a separate diagnostic.
comparison.stress_covariance_violation: Report magnitude and volume for SST; do not clip or relabel SA stress work as a turbulence source.

separation_of_errors: For each output the iteration, CFD-mesh, field-mesh and resampling indicators must each be below 10% of the smallest nonzero scenario change being interpreted; otherwise call that response unresolved.
uncertainty: Reference uncertainty must come from its source. If unavailable, report nominal-reference distances only and block uncertainty-coverage claims.
retention: Keep every failed, unsupported and missing scenario. All must reach the requested final field before counting as completed.

calibration_selection.prerequisite: Source-supported reference intervals and numerical gates must be ready; nominal point tables alone do not qualify physical uncertainty.
calibration_selection.criterion: For each parent model, require zero interval miss at all six calibration outputs and mean scenario width divided by fixed Cf scale <= 0.2.
calibration_selection.selection: Choose the smallest candidate epsilon meeting both criteria. If none passes, retain failure of this field family; do not retune using held-out responses.
calibration_selection.threshold_status: Proposed pre-run study choice, not a measured uncertainty or guaranteed achievable target
